plugins.description: AI-driven Playwright + TypeScript test automation kit. 14 skills: 8 knowledge skills (locators, POM, fixtures, test-organization, forms-and-dates, assertions, test-data, api-testing), 1 tool reference (cli-tool), and 5 workflow skills (/pw-kit:new-test, /pw-kit:fix-test, /pw-kit:pre-pr, /pw-kit:create-test-cases, /pw-kit:init). Works with any modern web framework (React, Vue, Angular).
